zh: 可信赖偿还欠款的；信誉好的；信用可靠的；借贷安全的
en: able to be trusted to pay back money that is owed; safe to lend money to
a set of beliefs
the ability or the wish to believe that something is real or true
ex: The plot of the novel stretches credulity to the limit (= it is almost impossible to believe).
这部小说的情节牵强得几乎令人无法相信。

en: too ready to believe things and therefore easy to trick

zh: 克里人（美洲土著，很多居于加拿大中部）
en: a member of a Native American people, many of whom live in central Canada

zh: 信念；原则；纲领；宗教信仰
en: a set of principles or religious beliefs
ex: We welcome people of all races, colours and creeds.
我们欢迎各种种族，肤色和信仰的人们。

en: a narrow area of water where the sea flows into the land
ex: They drove to the little creek where they kept their fishing boat.
他们驱车来到小港湾，那里是他们停放渔船的地方。

en: a basket for holding fish that have just been caught

zh: 悄悄地缓慢行进；蹑手蹑脚地移动
非常缓慢地行进；不知不觉产生；渐渐出现
en: to move slowly, quietly and carefully, because you do not want to be seen or heard
ex: I crept up the stairs, trying not to wake my parents.
为了尽量不吵醒父母，我蹑手蹑脚地上了楼。

en: to begin to happen or affect something
ex: As she became more tired, errors began to creep into her work.
由于越来越疲劳，她的工作开始出现差错。

en: to begin to happen or affect something
ex: As she became more tired, errors began to creep into her work.
由于越来越疲劳，她的工作开始出现差错。

zh: 使人感到害怕（或不舒服、恶心）
en: to give somebody an unpleasant feeling of fear or worry
ex: He said the empty streets creeped him out.
他说空旷的街道令他毛骨悚然。

en: to gradually increase in amount, price, etc.
ex: House prices are creeping up again.
住房价格又在渐渐上涨。

zh: （通常从后面）缓慢地悄悄靠近
（尤指不知不觉地）开始影响（某人）
en: to move slowly nearer to somebody, usually from behind, without being seen or heard
ex: Don't creep up on me like that!
别那样蹑手蹑脚地靠近我！

en: a plant that grows along the ground, up walls, etc., often winding itself around other plants

zh: （不知不觉地）逐渐发生的，缓慢行进的
en: happening or moving gradually and not easily noticed
ex: creeping inflation
慢慢加剧的通货膨胀

zh: 令人毛骨悚然的；令人不寒而栗的
怪异的，离奇的（使人感到紧张）
en: causing an unpleasant feeling of fear or slight horror
ex: a creepy ghost story
令人毛骨悚然的鬼故事

en: an insect, a worm, etc. when you think of it as unpleasant
